induction experiment data set constructor

induction_experiment.Rd

induction experiment data set constructor

Usage

induction_experiment(data = NULL, precipitant = "")

Arguments

data

A data frame.

precipitant

The precipitant.

Value

induction_experiment object.

Examples

induction_experiment(examplinib_in_vitro_ind, "examplinib")
